/*
================================================================================
项目：繁体 CBT｜长周期、高等级用户的副本进程（按累计付费分层）

筛选口径：
1. 测试窗口内有 login 的自然日 >= 4（即「玩超过三天」）；
2. 测试窗口内 daily_role_snapshot 的最高 role_lev > 30；快照分区向后取一天，
   以覆盖日结快照的落盘延迟；
3. 有效付费仅计 charge，排除 sandbox / is_freebuy，并按当日汇率换算 USD；
4. 付费档位：未付费、0<累计付费<10 USD、10<=累计付费<100 USD、累计付费>=100 USD。

结果模块：
- eligible_user_detail：符合条件用户明细，含主线进程；
- mainline_summary：各付费档位的平均主线通关子关数（基于不同主线子关挑战数 - 1 的代理值）；
- nonmain_stage_progress：各档位在每个非主线副本关卡的参与人数、挑战次数和渗透率。
================================================================================
*/
WITH Config AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' AS start_date, DATE '2026-08-04' AS end_date
),
UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
LoginDays AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE)) AS active_login_days
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
      AND e."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002', '91110', '91111')
    GROUP BY 1
),
RoleLevel AS (
    SELECT
        -- daily_role_snapshot 的角色账号字段为 lid；与事件 #account_id 对应。
        e.lid AS account_id,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(e.role_lev AS BIGINT)) AS max_role_level
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE_ADD('day', 1, c.start_date) AND DATE_ADD('day', 1, c.end_date)
      AND e."$part_event" = 'daily_role_snapshot'
      AND e.lid IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND CAST(e.lid AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002', '91110', '91111')
    GROUP BY 1
),
ValidPay AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1) AS pay_amount_usd
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date" = x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency = x.currency
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND CAST(e."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) NOT IN ('4100002', '91110', '91111')
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),
PayAgg AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_pay_times, ROUND(SUM(pay_amount_usd), 2) AS total_pay_usd
    FROM ValidPay
    GROUP BY 1
),
EligibleUsers AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        l.active_login_days,
        r.max_role_level,
        COALESCE(p.valid_pay_times, 0) AS valid_pay_times,
        COALESCE(p.total_pay_usd, 0.0) AS total_pay_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.total_pay_usd, 0.0) = 0 THEN '未付费'
            WHEN p.total_pay_usd < 10 THEN '付费<10 USD'
            WHEN p.total_pay_usd < 100 THEN '付费10–<100 USD'
            WHEN p.total_pay_usd >= 100 THEN '付费>=100 USD'
        END AS payment_tier
    FROM LoginDays l
    INNER JOIN RoleLevel r ON l.account_id = r.account_id
    LEFT JOIN PayAgg p ON l.account_id = p.account_id
    WHERE l.active_login_days >= 4
      AND r.max_role_level > 30
      AND COALESCE(p.total_pay_usd, 0.0) >= 0
),
MainlineProgress AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT)) - 1, 0) AS inferred_mainline_passed_children,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT)) AS max_mainline_child_stage_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    INNER JOIN EligibleUsers u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
StageMap AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") AS stage_name_show,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") AS stage_name_real
    FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765
    GROUP BY 1
),
TierSize AS (
    SELECT payment_tier, COUNT(*) AS eligible_users
    FROM EligibleUsers
    GROUP BY 1
),
MainlineSummary AS (
    SELECT
        u.payment_tier,
        COUNT(*) AS eligible_users,
        ROUND(AVG(u.active_login_days), 2) AS avg_active_login_days,
        ROUND(AVG(u.max_role_level), 2) AS avg_max_role_level,
        ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(m.inferred_mainline_passed_children, 0)), 2) AS avg_inferred_mainline_passed_children,
        ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(m.max_mainline_child_stage_id, 0)), 2) AS avg_max_mainline_child_stage_id
    FROM EligibleUsers u
    LEFT JOIN MainlineProgress m ON u.account_id = m.account_id
    GROUP BY 1
),
DimStage AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        (1002,'挑战玩具小偷'), (1003,'挑战怪物扭蛋人'), (1005,'守护古老城市'),
        (1004,'竞技场'), (1018,'挑战邪恶的兔兔玩偶'), (1019,'挑战邪恶喵巴士'),
        (1006,'守护海滩'), (1007,'恐龙拳手大挑战'), (1022,'花圃内PVP副本'),
        (1008,'影像副本'), (1023,'切磋'), (1009,'穿越魔法之门'), (1021,'积木大乱斗'),
        (1024,'跨服竞技场'), (1010,'宝物预览副本'), (1011,'忍道・甜酸试炼'),
        (1012,'冒险试炼'), (1013,'宠物旅行'), (1014,'动感超人试炼—钻地土拨鼠'),
        (1015,'动感超人试炼—挖铲土拨鼠'), (1016,'动感超人试炼—挖矿土拨鼠'),
        (1017,'动感超人比赛'), (1020,'社团大评比')
    ) AS t(stage_type, stage_name)
),
NonMainStageProgress AS (
    SELECT
        u.payment_tier,
        TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
        ds.stage_name,
        TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e."#account_id") AS fight_users,
        COUNT(*) AS fight_times
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    INNER JOIN EligibleUsers u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN DimStage ds ON TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = ds.stage_type
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) <> 1001
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
UserNonMainMaxStage AS (
    SELECT
        u.account_id,
        u.payment_tier,
        TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) AS stage_type,
        COALESCE(ds.stage_name, CONCAT('未映射副本_', CAST(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR))) AS stage_name,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS max_stage_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    INNER JOIN EligibleUsers u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN DimStage ds ON TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = ds.stage_type
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) <> 1001
      AND TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
IDMapping AS (
    SELECT distinct_id, account_id, user_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            e."#distinct_id" AS distinct_id,
            e."#account_id" AS account_id,
            e."#user_id" AS user_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e."#distinct_id" ORDER BY e."#event_time" DESC) AS rn
        FROM ta.v_event_18 e
        CROSS JOIN Config c
        LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
        WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
          AND e."$part_event" = 'login'
          AND e."#distinct_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND b.user_id IS NULL
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
UserRescueXiaobaiMaxStage AS (
    SELECT
        u.account_id,
        u.payment_tier,
        9999 AS stage_type,
        '拯救小白' AS stage_name,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS max_stage_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    LEFT JOIN IDMapping im ON e."#distinct_id" = im.distinct_id
    INNER JOIN EligibleUsers u ON COALESCE(e."#account_id", im.account_id) = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON COALESCE(e."#user_id", im.user_id) = b.user_id
    WHERE CAST(e."$part_date" AS DATE) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
      AND e."#event_name" = 'shriosaving_fight'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
UserModeMaxStage AS (
    SELECT account_id, payment_tier, stage_type, stage_name, max_stage_id
    FROM UserNonMainMaxStage
    UNION ALL
    SELECT account_id, payment_tier, stage_type, stage_name, max_stage_id
    FROM UserRescueXiaobaiMaxStage
),
UserModeMaxWide AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1002 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_toy_thief,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1003 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_gashapon_monster,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1005 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_ancient_city,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1004 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_arena,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1018 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_evil_bunny,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1019 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_evil_catbus,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1006 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_beach,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1007 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_dinosaur_boxer,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1022 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_garden_pvp,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1008 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_video,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1023 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_sparring,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1009 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_magic_door,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1021 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_block_brawl,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1024 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_cross_arena,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1010 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_treasure_preview,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1011 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_ninja_trial,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1012 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_adventure_trial,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1013 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_pet_travel,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1014 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_mole_drill,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1015 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_mole_shovel,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1016 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_mole_mining,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1017 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_superman_match,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 1020 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_guild_competition,
        MAX(CASE WHEN stage_type = 9999 THEN max_stage_id END) AS max_rescue_xiaobai
    FROM UserModeMaxStage
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    'eligible_user_detail' AS "数据模块",
    u.payment_tier AS "付费档位",
    CAST(u.account_id AS VARCHAR) AS "账号ID",
    u.active_login_days AS "活跃登录天数",
    u.max_role_level AS "最高角色等级",
    u.total_pay_usd AS "累计付费USD",
    u.valid_pay_times AS "有效付费次数",
    COALESCE(m.inferred_mainline_passed_children, 0) AS "主线通关子关数_代理值",
    COALESCE(m.max_mainline_child_stage_id, 0) AS "最高主线子关ID",
    COALESCE(sm.stage_name_show, '未挑战主线') AS "最高主线小关",
    COALESCE(sm.stage_name_real, '未挑战主线') AS "最高主线子关",
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "副本类型ID",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "副本名称",
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "副本关卡ID",
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "副本参与人数",
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "副本挑战次数",
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS "副本参与率%",
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "符合条件用户数",
    w.max_toy_thief AS "挑战玩具小偷最高关卡",
    w.max_gashapon_monster AS "挑战怪物扭蛋人最高关卡",
    w.max_ancient_city AS "守护古老城市最高关卡",
    w.max_arena AS "竞技场最高关卡",
    w.max_evil_bunny AS "挑战邪恶兔兔玩偶最高关卡",
    w.max_evil_catbus AS "挑战邪恶喵巴士最高关卡",
    w.max_beach AS "守护海滩最高关卡",
    w.max_dinosaur_boxer AS "恐龙拳手大挑战最高关卡",
    w.max_garden_pvp AS "花圃PVP副本最高关卡",
    w.max_video AS "影像副本最高关卡",
    w.max_sparring AS "切磋最高关卡",
    w.max_magic_door AS "穿越魔法之门最高关卡",
    w.max_block_brawl AS "积木大乱斗最高关卡",
    w.max_cross_arena AS "跨服竞技场最高关卡",
    w.max_treasure_preview AS "宝物预览副本最高关卡",
    w.max_ninja_trial AS "忍道甜酸试炼最高关卡",
    w.max_adventure_trial AS "冒险试炼最高关卡",
    w.max_pet_travel AS "宠物旅行最高关卡",
    w.max_mole_drill AS "钻地土拨鼠试炼最高关卡",
    w.max_mole_shovel AS "挖铲土拨鼠试炼最高关卡",
    w.max_mole_mining AS "挖矿土拨鼠试炼最高关卡",
    w.max_superman_match AS "动感超人比赛最高关卡",
    w.max_guild_competition AS "社团大评比最高关卡",
    w.max_rescue_xiaobai AS "拯救小白最高关卡"
FROM EligibleUsers u
LEFT JOIN MainlineProgress m ON u.account_id = m.account_id
LEFT JOIN StageMap sm ON m.max_mainline_child_stage_id = sm.stage_id
LEFT JOIN UserModeMaxWide w ON u.account_id = w.account_id

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'mainline_summary', s.payment_tier, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
    CAST(s.avg_active_login_days AS BIGINT), CAST(s.avg_max_role_level AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), s.avg_inferred_mainline_passed_children,
    s.avg_max_mainline_child_stage_id, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), s.eligible_users,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
FROM MainlineSummary s

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'nonmain_stage_progress', n.payment_tier, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
    n.stage_type, COALESCE(n.stage_name, CONCAT('未映射副本_', CAST(n.stage_type AS VARCHAR))), n.stage_id,
    n.fight_users, n.fight_times, ROUND(100.0 * n.fight_users / NULLIF(t.eligible_users, 0), 2), t.eligible_users,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
FROM NonMainStageProgress n
INNER JOIN TierSize t ON n.payment_tier = t.payment_tier
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 12, 14;
